description.value:
Prerequisites: the mech must have a recon frame and the magical subtype to install this component.

The mech's sensors can detect magic as if under the effects of arcane sight. An operator can use a mech's standard action to use the actions outlined under the spell. The mech can also be controlled by its operator to cast clairaudience/clairvoyance at five times the range using its mech's as the caster level but expending a spell slot as normal.

Auxiliary Slots: 1.
